name: AdShields
description:
AdShields is a creative operations hub for performance teams: a cloud library where you store, organize, and reuse all your videos and VSLs — from the first cut to the approved creative.

With the MCP connector, you connect Claude to your AdShields account and operate the platform in natural language, without leaving the chat. The assistant sees your organizations, videos, boards, and comments with YOUR permissions and acts on your behalf.

What you can ask Claude to do:
• Browse and search your library — list videos and VSLs by organization, status, or type (creative/VSL).
• Write and revise scripts — create drafts, rewrite copy, and structure the script in blocks.
• Collaborate — comment on specific passages of the copy or at the exact second of the video to guide the team.
• Define scenes — map the visual direction for each part of the text (scenes and shots).
• Approve creatives — mark versions as approved when they're ready to run.
• Track the operation — check boards and the status of each creative.

Security & privacy:
• OAuth 2.0 authentication — you authorize access and choose the organizations; you can revoke at any time.
• Per-organization scope — the assistant only sees resources you already have access to, never data from other workspaces.
• Every action runs with your permissions and is recorded in an audit trail.

Built for media buyers, producers, and agencies that operate creative at volume and want briefing, versioning, review, and approval in a single flow — now also in natural language.

_published_faq.name: How do I add AdShields to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AdShields to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.adshields.pro/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the AdShields MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: AdShields lists 16 MCP tools, including add_comment, approve_video, attach_scene_image, delete_scene, draft_video, get_scene_images, get_video, list_boards, list_orgs, list_team_members, list_videos, and remove_scene_image.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to AdShields?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to AdShields in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
AdShields requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
AdShields is developed by AdShields. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
